stem.text: The first ionisation energies of twenty successive elements in the Periodic Table are represented in the graph.
The letters given are not the normal symbols for these elements.

stem.alt: Graph of first ionisation energy in kJ mol-1 (0 to 2500) against elements labelled A to T. Peaks at B, J and R; minima near C, K and S.

stem.text: Which statements about this graph are correct?

items: Elements B, J and R are in Group 18 of the Periodic Table.
Atoms of elements D and L contain two electrons in their outer shells.
Atoms of elements G and O contain a half-filled p subshell.
